svg.title: The check-in image pipeline
svg.desc: From five photos to eleven readings judged against the person's own noise band, then explained by Gemini.
svg.text: Photos in, eleven readings out, each judged against your own noise band. Gemini only writes the words.
IN THE BROWSER AND THE API
IN THE ENGINE · CLOUD RUN, PRIVATE
calls it with an ID token
RAW: a card or white paper
ELEVEN READINGS, MEASURED ON EVERY USABLE PHOTO
THRESHOLDS ARE RELATIVE TO YOUR OWN SKIN
atan2(L* − 50, b*) per cheek; descriptive, never ranked
mean of the regions’ median a* on cheeks and nose
spread of region L*, plus melanin index within regions
darker than your own skin nearby; seen in 2+ photos
round, redder than your skin nearby; crops kept
dark blobs 0.05–0.3 mm per cm²; the iris sets scale
RMS Laplacian of L* at 0.4 mm, divided by mean L*
under-eye L* minus the same side’s cheek L*
Hessian ridges 0.6–1 mm, at least 5 mm long; mm per cm²
share of the T-zone brighter and greyer than skin nearby
cheek L*, chroma and smoothness; your change only
spot thresholds scale with your own lightness
JUDGE AGAINST YOUR OWN NORMAL RANGE
each reading on every photo that
passed the gates: mean and SD;
the sharpest front photo is the

range. No band yet: no verdict.

each asked twice in a different
